name: I love China Sm (Pro Scout)
author: Yony

notes: 5@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ to collect 50@resource/resource_wood.webp@, then to @resource/sheep.webp@, 1@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to build @building_economy/mill.webp@ behind TC and next to wood line

Once 5@resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ collect 50 wood, 1@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to build @building_chinese/village.webp@ next to @building_economy/mill.webp@, then that @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@

4 age up@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ will go on @resource/resource_wood.webp@,  @resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_wood.webp@ until 12 - @resource/rally.webp@ to the first tree you chopped down for quick gathering
Gather the @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ until second @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ pops out

Immediately queue @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ until you have 4/4, first will supervise @building_economy/mill.webp@ (collect & drop off 40 @resource/resource_gold.webp@ with first @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ before supervising).

When second @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ pops out, pull all @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to make a @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ & have @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ supervise while building - any @resource/resource_wood.webp@ the @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ are carrying will be boosted once @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ is completed
Third @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ can just be left to roam and collect @resource/resource_gold.webp@ from buildings
Build a @building_military/stable.webp@ ASAP to produce @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ for @technology_economy/professional-scouts.webp@

As you approach the 300@resource/resource_gold.webp@ needed for @technology_economy/professional-scouts.webp@, pull all @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ onto @resource/resource_wood.webp@, then @resource/rally.webp@@resource/sheep.webp@
Fourth @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ will supervise @building_military/stable.webp@ for fast @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ production (make 4-6)

Once @technology_economy/professional-scouts.webp@ is researched, next upgrade will be @technology_chinese/imperial-examination.webp@ (Very easy to forget as it's inside the landmark but very important!!!)

description: The Villager #'s aren't perfect as it can vary based on map/opponent civ/how quickly you can macro - more of just an outline that you can play around with!
